summary: Public projects created on 10 December 2025: 3 repos and 2 datasets.
intro: Speech recognition evaluations covered an index of ASR benchmarks, a transcription cleanup comparison across cloud audio models, and a test of Whisper fine-tunes against stock Whisper on local inference. The accompanying datasets were a small speech-to-text set of 92 audio samples with ground truth transcriptions and a fine-tune evaluation set.

projects.name: Speech And ASR Evaluations
projects.description: Index repository for speech recognition and ASR evaluations

projects.name: Transcription Cleanup Eval 1225
projects.description: Evaluating various cloud audio understanding models on the transcribe and cleanup workflow/task

projects.name: Whisper Fine Tune Accuracy Eval
projects.description: Comparing Whisper fine-tunes versus stock Whisper on local inference

projects.name: Small STT Eval Audio Dataset
projects.description: A small speech-to-text evaluation dataset containing 92 audio samples with ground truth transcriptions.
